// Writes a project state from this (old) version of Batida, as a fixture for
// the current version's tests.
#include "Plugin/PluginProcessor.h"

int main (int argc, char* argv[])
{
    juce::ScopedJuceInitialiser_GUI gui;
    const juce::File out (argv[1]);
    const juce::File tone ("/tmp/batida-fixture/old-tone.wav"); // gone when the fixture loads
    tone.getParentDirectory().createDirectory();
    {
        juce::AudioBuffer<float> b (1, 4800);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4800; ++i)
            b.setSample (0, i, 0.5f * std::sin (6.2831853f * 220.0f * (float) i / 48000.0f));
        std::unique_ptr<juce::OutputStream> os (tone.createOutputStream());
        juce::WavAudioFormat wav;
        if (auto w = wav.createWriterFor (os, juce::AudioFormatWriterOptions {}.withSampleRate (48000.0).withNumChannels (1).withBitsPerSample (16)))
            w->writeFromAudioSampleBuffer (b, 0, 4800);
    }
    BatidaProcessor proc;
    proc.prepareToPlay (48000.0, 512);
    auto set = [&] (const char* id, float value)
    {
        auto* p = proc.getState().getParameter (id);
        p->setValueNotifyingHost (p->convertTo0to1 (value));
    };
    set ("v1_level", -7.5f);
    set ("xy_y", 0.6f);
    set ("v8_amp_decay", 900.0f);
    proc.setVoiceName (2, "Crack");
    proc.loadSample (3, tone);
    proc.patterns().edit ([] (batida::PatternBank& b) { b.patterns[2].tracks[4].steps[9].gate = true; b.patterns[2].length = 24; });
    juce::MemoryBlock state;
    proc.getStateInformation (state);
    out.replaceWithData (state.getData(), state.getSize());
    tone.deleteFile();
    std::printf ("wrote %s (%d bytes)\n", out.getFullPathName().toRawUTF8(), (int) state.getSize());
    return 0;
}
